decisions.reason: The flagship turnaround software has its own page and still has uncertain upside, and keeping a software option costs little, so the option stays open.
The connectivity module is a cheap-to-maintain complement to the apron suite, and one year of results does not reveal enough to justify abandoning it.
Revenue and billing software sits further from the core electrical equipment business, but its marginal cost is low and uncertainty about its value has not yet resolved.
Equipment monitoring builds directly on the firm's hardware base and serves as a low-cost option for digital service revenue that is still unresolved.
The resource management module may overlap with the turnaround software but is cheap to keep while the market response is still unclear.
As a service, the safety alert carries somewhat higher ongoing costs and is only mentioned on the site, but it is too early to conclude its value will not be realized.
